about: Frame annotations for the Leeroy Jenkins replay spike (issue #1543).

Annotated by a vision model (Claude) reading frames of the official 480p upload: 5 fps for 86-116 s, 4 fps for 130-138 s, 1 fps elsewhere. Roster and classes are cross-checked with fan sources and labelled as such.
World positions are HAND KEYFRAMES, not a camera solve: map 229 has no published mesh yet, so screen positions could not be projected onto a floor.
They are placed with the real geometry we do have: the Rookery's 198 floor eggs and Father Flame (CMaNGOS spawns, rookery-spawns.json) and Pyroguard Emberseer's Hall of Binding to the north.
Every field says where it came from: observed (seen in the frames), inferred (from the story or layout), or illustrative (filler so the replay reads; not seen).

video.title: A Rough Go - Leeroy Jenkins
video.channel: Anf Pal (the guild's own upload, 2005 original)

clip.note: The 20 s spike (charge 93 s -> pile-in -> 113 s) plus the POV party's wipe at 131-136 s, so deaths are inside the clip.

places.source: map 229 mesh (orchestrator render, calibrated against real Rookery pulls) and real pull positions: groups come down stairs from the upper Hall of Binding (z ~111) at y ~-314 onto a terrace (z 106.4) along the Rookery's north side; the eggs lie on the floor below (z 91.5). Leeroy and the POV reach the eggs 2 s after the door, so they drop off the terrace edge (the 95.2 s frame looks down from it).

observations.what: Raid stacked in the Hall of Binding beside a doorway; nameplates Forekin, Abduhl, Jamaal, Ritter, Madtoker, Basphemy, Therien, Ctidalwave, Juron, Spiffy.
A runner leaves the stack for the door; the raid turns after him.
Anfrony (POV) follows the runner through the stone doorway, Juron beside the camera.
Minimap now 'The Rookery'. Leeroy (paladin) on the checkered floor among eggs and bones; Ritter right of the camera.
First Rookery Whelp nameplates over Leeroy's position.
Forekin and Abduhl arrive at the pile; ~10 whelp nameplates.
Ritter, Spiffy, Basphemy and Abduhl in the pile.
Anfrony (POV)'s fear: purple skulls over ~6 whelps; more eggs ahead of the camera.
Anfrony (POV) health about half (player frame turns yellow).
Whelps spread over the room; Forekin fighting at 113 s.
Anfrony (POV) is backing out over grey stone towards the east side of the room.
Anfrony (POV) party: slot 2 health goes red.
Slot 4 portrait grey (dead): every other member of the Anfrony (POV) party is down.
